topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't believe this! Your invention, your brainchild, and someone else has snatched the patent. It’s unbelievable, but you know what? This isn’t the end. It’s just a setback, a bump, not even a roadblock. You’ve got this incredible idea, and one thing I know for sure is that when one door slams shut, you’re the type to kick open a window, maybe even a whole wall. Think about it—how can you tweak it? Make it better, bigger, more amazing. Maybe there’s a whole new angle, something even more groundbreaking. You’re a genius, no doubt about it. This is just the universe’s way of saying, “Level up.” Let’s do this!
